description: A synthetic pull request. Every source file is authored as an array of physical lines, each element carrying its own exact terminator (LF, CRLF, or none for a final line without a terminal newline). Patches are authored the same way. Each diff entry also carries a hand-authored `surface`: its hunks as ordered display rows [baseLine, headLine], where [b, null] is a deletion, [null, h] an addition and [b, h] unchanged context. The surface is test oracle data only and is never passed to the mapper. Expected locations in placement-cases.json are written by hand against these arrays, never computed by the mapper under test. `baseCommit` names the verified commit whose text is the diff's LEFT side (for a GitHub pull request, the merge base), not the base branch tip.

reorderedAdjacent.description: A valid unified diff of adjacent.txt that interleaves deletions and additions (-c +C -d +D). Git does not emit this ordering, so it is excluded from the git cross-check; the surface regeneration check still verifies it.
